turns.text: What I had to learn to do was to first get out of my own head.
turns.zh: 我必须学会做的，首先是别老在自己脑子里打转。

turns.text: It is not an easy thing to do, and it takes practice.
turns.zh: 这真不是件容易的事，得靠练习。

turns.text: But part of what this book is reminding us is that there are no miracle answers to these things: overcoming imposter syndrome, feeling like you belong, right?
turns.zh: 但这本书部分是在提醒我们：这些事情没有奇迹般的答案——克服冒名顶替综合征、找到归属感，对吧？

turns.text: These are the three steps you take to feeling seen,” right?
turns.zh: 「这三步就能让你感到被看见」，对吧？
